modern:
The cyclical movements of the universe are the same, up and down from age to age. And either the universal intelligence sets itself in motion for every separate effect, and if this is so, be content with what results from its activity; or it set itself in motion once, and everything else follows in a sort of sequence; or indivisible elements are the origin of all things.—In a word, if there is a god, all is well; and if chance rules, do not you too be governed by it.

Soon the earth will cover us all: then the earth too will change, and the things that result from change will also go on changing forever, and these again forever. For if a man reflects on the changes and transformations which follow one another like wave after wave, and on their speed, he will despise everything which is perishable.
original:
The periodic movements of the universe are the same, up and down from age to age. And either the universal intelligence puts itself in motion for every separate effect, and if this is so, be thou content with that which is the result of its activity; or it puts itself in motion once, and everything else comes by way of sequence in a manner; or indivisible elements are the origin of all things.—In a word, if there is a god, all is well; and if chance rules, do not thou also be governed by it.

Soon will the earth cover us all: then the earth, too, will change, and the things also which result from change will continue to change forever, and these again forever. For if a man reflects on the changes and transformations which follow one another like wave after wave and their rapidity, he will despise everything which is perishable.

explained.summary:
The world goes round in the same cycles, age after age. Either a divine mind acts on each event, in which case accept what it does, or it set things going once and the rest follows, or it’s all just atoms. Put simply: if there’s a god, all is well; if it’s all chance, you at least don’t have to act at random.

Soon the earth will cover us all, then change itself, and keep changing forever. Watching wave after wave of change, and how fast it comes, you’ll stop putting much value on anything that doesn’t last.
